title: Integrative multi-omics analysis identifies methylation-associated lncRNAs FAM83A-AS2 and AC012213.1 as candidate prognostic markers in lung adenocarcinoma

evidence_spans.quote: Results By integrating RNA-seq and Illumina 450K methylation data
Cox models (adjusted for age, sex, and tumor stage)

scope_reviewer.concise_rationale: This empirical analysis concerns lung adenocarcinoma; age is used only as an adjustment covariate, with no analyzed aging construct.

causal_design_reviewer.exposure_or_intervention: Promoter methylation associated with lncRNA expression
causal_design_reviewer.estimand_or_contrast: Association with poorer overall survival in Kaplan–Meier and Cox models

evidence_spans.quote: By integrating RNA-seq and Illumina 450K methylation data from 473 LUAD and 32 normal lung samples in TCGA, we identified 2,668 differentially expressed lncRNAs and 20,843 differentially methylated CpG sites.
Spearman correlation analysis highlighted seven lncRNAs with inverse promoter methylation–expression patterns
A two-lncRNA prognostic score derived using LASSO Cox regression showed moderate time-dependent discrimination

causal_design_reviewer.concise_rationale: The report presents completed analyses of TCGA data, but its stated analyses are differential profiling, correlation, survival association, and prediction rather than an applied qualifying causal or perturbation design.

directional_result_reviewer.concise_rationale: The abstract reports a current-result clause asserting miRNA-mediated regulation.
